name: app_creator_app
label: App Creator
subtitle: Scaffold a new SciTeX app from a starter
about: Create and validate leaf applications with the shared SciTeX SDK appmaker. Each application owns its Django GUI and runs standalone or as a Hub plugin.
description: SciTeX App Creator serves the appmaker engine (scaffold, validate, dev-install, publish) as a browser wizard. New app from starter (label, description, starter card), inline validation feedback, and publish/dev-install hooks against a SciTeX Cloud server. Served from the SDK via `scitex-sdk gui serve`; scitex-hub mounts this same Django app for its create-app tile.
author: scitex-ai
capabilities: Scaffold a new app from a starter (label, description, starter card)
Validate a scaffolded app and show errors plus advisory notices
Dev-install an app to a SciTeX Cloud server for immediate testing
Submit an app for review and publication
